environment.container: disposable, tmpfs data, port bound to 127.0.0.1; removed after test
environment.stripe: no external requests; synthetic Payment rows and local use cases only

newScenario.concurrentFulfilment: two ACCESS_30D payments are fulfilled concurrently and both IDs/durations are retained
newScenario.concurrentRefund: full refunds for both payments run concurrently; serialized pass updates leave an empty contribution list, expired access, and zero payment total
newScenario.replay: concurrent replay of both full refunds does not change the final state

limitations: No Stripe API or webhook was invoked; provider behavior remains separately tested with controlled fakes.
Legacy backfill ambiguity, owner policy, non-production provider acceptance, and independent review remain open.
